   # `<>` — binary construction `<<L/binary, R/binary>>` (Rian.Beam), not an op.
   def inflate(FConcat(l, r)) := {:bin, 0, [{:bin_element, 0, inflate(l), :default, [:binary]}, {:bin_element, 0, inflate(r), :default, [:binary]}]}
+  # a variadic single-shot binary join (str_concat_all) — one `<<seg, …>>` form.
